_about: Data for Assets/Editor/CharacterSetup.cs (Hades > Characters > Set up enemy / player from roster row). Editor only (HCKIT3 build_config editorOnlyData may skip it in the player). A new monster = one roster.json row + its glb/controller assets; the rig profile below supplies the bone / socket names that JoanSwap used to hold for one character. controllerTemplate = the null-motion template (laneCLIPBUILD Tools > Combat > Create Null-Motion Clip Template). stateSources = where EnsureStates looks for an already baked <state>.anim. Roster optional keys read by the editor tools: clipSet (attack_clips.json / dodge_clips.json clipSets id), templateFor ("player" | "enemy": the scene object cloned for that role), lightLayerGroup ("lit" | "restore"; default: the enemy restores, everyone else is lit).
